ground.text: Where do my feet meet the floor?
What happens if I slow my exhale?
Where is my body being supported right now?
Can I feel the air on my skin?

explore.text: Where do I feel this most?
Where does this sensation start and end?
Is this sensation on the surface, or deeper?
Are the edges sharp or soft?
Is there a rhythm to it?
How strong is it right now?
Does it change when I breathe?
If this had a word or an image, what would it be?
Does that word fit, or is there a better one?

allow.text: Can I make a little room for this?
Can I let this be here, just as it is?
Can I say hello to what's here?
What does this part of me need right now?
Can I meet this with kindness?
Who else might be feeling something like this right now?
Can I let this wave move through me?
What happens if I simply watch it?
